data.feel: Sleek futuristic attack helicopter — an Apache reimagined. Fast and nimble for a gunship, thinly armoured but tanky against fire, it lives on its stub-wing missile rails: point the nose and rip a SWARM of fire-and-forget seekers downrange, no lock, no warning. The chin gun is an afterthought — a light peashooter to finish cripples. Glass-cannon: it hits like a truck and folds if you let it get hit back.
